question: How can a participant react on the shared expense assignment?

youtubeLink.caption: Plantour Participant React On Shared Expense
youtubeLink.description: This video explains how a participant can react on the shared expense assignment

sections.beforeHtml: A participant reviews their assigned shared amount from the Trip participants page. The control appears only on the current participant`s own row when a shared amount is assigned.
items: Open Dashboard > Trip personal > Participants for the selected trip.
Find your own participant row. Plantour shows the shared assignment status there, including the deadline when one is set.
Leave the assignment active when you plan to pay your share. Your shared payment progress is then tracked from personal Trip expenses.
Turn on the Rejected checkbox if you do not want to keep that assigned shared amount.
When Rejected is checked, Plantour marks your current shared assignment as rejected so the admin can review and update it.
When Rejected is cleared again, the assignment becomes active and can be tracked through your personal shared payments.
sections.afterHtml: Keep the assignment active when you want to pay against it. Then continue with How does a participant track an assigned shared balance?.
